name: MCN5
tagline: 90 mm Intel mini PC with onboard LPDDR5 and three display ports
description: MCN5 fits Intel N-series options, onboard LPDDR5-4800 memory and dual Gigabit LAN into a 90 x 90 x 38.5 mm enclosure. Two HDMI 2.0 ports and DisplayPort 1.4 provide three display connections. M.2 2242 SATA / NVMe storage, three USB 3.2 ports, two 10 Gbps Type-C ports and TPM 2.0 support complete the platform.
featureHeading: Compact desktop connections and clear configuration choices
advantageSummary: Compare the memory, display, storage and wireless options for this model, including TPM 2.0 support and the listed power and environment limits.

features.title: Storage and wireless options
features.description: The M.2 2242 slot accepts SATA or NVMe PCIe 3.0 SSDs. Wi-Fi 5 / 6 and Bluetooth 4.2 / 5.2 configurations are listed, with TPM 2.0 support.
